papers.title_en: Provably Good Prim-Dijkstra Revisited: New Theory and a Practical Algorithm for a Classical VLSI Routing Problem with LLMs
papers.evidence: LLM辅助地重新审视VLSI布线问题，包含形式证明和反例，展示了LLM在硬件形式验证中的适用性
papers.tldr: LLM使经典VLSI布线问题Prim-Dijkstra路由得以重新审视。本文证明了该问题的弱NP完全性，推导了连续成本半径权衡并给出(2,2)平衡保证，提出基于高度划分的多模式求解器HP-RCRST。在28个开发实例上，强模式在23个上帕累托支配已发表方法的并集，在5个上持平。该案例展示了矛盾猜想、反例、形式验证与实现如何重启被忽视的问题。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models may make precise but dormant algorithmic problems practical to revisit, and may expose new paths toward fundamental ones. We demonstrate this possibility through Prim-Dijkstra routing, a classic VLSI problem whose terminal-only Manhattan complexity remained open despite decades of practical work. We prove weak NP-completeness, derive a continuous cost-radius tradeoff with a balanced (2,2) guarantee, and build HP-RCRST, a height-partition-based multi-mode solver. On 28 development instances, its stronger modes Pareto-dominate the published-method union on 23 and tie on five. The case shows how conflicting conjectures, counterexamples, formal checks, and implementation can reopen neglected questions. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/CODA-Team/hp-rcrst.

papers.title_en: Solver-Hard Is Not Model-Hard: A Hardness-Controlled Diagnostic for LLM Constraint Reasoning
papers.evidence: 大语言模型在SAT实例上的约束推理能力评估，与形式验证相关
papers.tldr: LLM约束推理的评估常因随机SAT相变混淆密度与求解难度。本文通过控制子句密度、匹配公式大小，使用理论区分证明困难（expander-Tseitin）与容易（ladder-Tseitin）的公式，比较多个求解器和模型的表现。结果显示，在近似匹配密度下，模型准确度差距不显著且与求解器冲突方向相反；重标记暴露模型表面敏感性，token花费与难度不一致。该工作揭示solver-hard与model-hard的解离，强调评估需控制合成难度。
papers.abstract_en: LLM constraint reasoners are often evaluated near the random-SAT phase transition, confounding density and solver hardness. We test instance-level transfer while near-matching clause density. At aligned size bins, with near-matched density and matched maximum clause width, we compare proof-hard expander-Tseitin and proof-easy ladder-Tseitin formulas, pigeonhole anchors, and density-mismatched controls. Theory separates their resolution hardness; a solver-specific Glucose mean-conflict proxy differs by up to $51\times$, and five other solvers preserve the direction. Across three included models (243 instances each; a fourth is excluded for abstention), the near-matched-density accuracy gaps range from $-32$ to $+20$ points, with a pooled gap of $+1.7$ points ($p=0.74$) and a wrong-signed correctness-versus-conflict association ($r=+0.15$). A proof-preserving relabeling lowers accuracy in all five clusters for one model (mean $-93$ points) but not another, exposing model-surface sensitivity. In a preregistered extension, provider-reported completion-token spend does not consistently increase with the proxy after accounting for formula length and censoring. At 16k, the reasoning model spends more on proof-easy matched formulas and exhausts its budget on the solver-easiest UNSAT family; the 32k C1 gap is absent. These scoped dissociations concern verdict accuracy and observed token spend, not certificate solving, exact proof length, or allocation efficiency.
